free_tier.stated: Zero bytes hosted. Datarade is explicitly a discovery and brokerage layer: it 'doesn't host or deliver data, instead, it focuses on discovery, comparability, and transparency'. Providers list a data product with metadata and a link; the bytes stay wherever the provider already keeps them.

tooling: Provider Studio for listings, no storage API. There is no upload endpoint because there is no object store.
chaining: None. A listing is metadata; it consumes no quota and provides none.
limits_note: fails-quota absolutely. Even the commercial model is commission-only ($0/year + 30%, or $6,000/yr + 20%), so listing is free but delivers nothing.
reliability_note: Included to close the brief's item. Anyone reading 'data marketplace' as 'data storage' will waste a wave on this category — every member of it (Datarade, data.world, Snowflake Marketplace-style listings, AWS Data Exchange) hosts metadata, not bytes.
